name: RevenueSummary
description:
A revenue overview card: the period's total with a trend badge against the previous period, top markets, a trend chart and a row of key stats - composed from Badge, Icon and Sparkline.

  RevenueSummary(value: 48_210, previous: 42_900, period: :month) do
    RevenueMarkets do
      RevenueMarket(country: :us, value: 21_690, share: 45)
    end
    RevenueChart(data: monthly_totals, labels: month_names)
    RevenueStats do
      RevenueStat(label: :orders, value: 1_208)
      RevenueStat(label: :average_order, value: 39.9, money: true)
    end
  end

Localized: the strings are in revenue_summary.locales.yml next to this file (t(".key") in any part), country names in ui/countries.locales.yml. `period:` picks the title and the "vs … last month" wording; `title:` / `comparison:` override them. Money, counts and the change use the current locale's number formats (rails-i18n).
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `RevenueSummary(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

CountryFlag.description:
A rounded-square country flag (Appica's flag style), by ISO code. Only the flags the blocks use ship here; any other code renders its letters on a muted tile.

  CountryFlag(:us, class: "size-4")

RevenueChart.description: The trend line under the markets - a Sparkline with a gradient fill that pins itself to the bottom of the card. Hover it to read each period (in the root's currency and the locale).

RevenueMarket.description: One market row: flag, country name, amount and share of the total.

RevenueStat.description: One figure: a muted label over a bold value. `label:` may be a translation key (:orders, :average_order, :refunds, :conversion); `value:` is formatted as a number, or money with `money: true` - or pass the value as a block.

RevenueStats.description: Key figures under a divider, in equal columns.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes:
The Appica homepage card. The badge compares `value:` with `previous:`; hover the chart to
read each month.
examples.code:
phlex do
  RevenueSummary(value: value.to_f, previous: previous.to_f, period:, currency: currency.to_s, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    RevenueMarkets do
      RevenueMarket(country: :us, value: 21_690, share: 45)
      RevenueMarket(country: :de, value: 9_640, share: 20)
      RevenueMarket(country: :jp, value: 7_230, share: 15)
    end
    RevenueChart(data: REVENUE[0...-1] + [ value.to_f ], labels: I18n.t("date.abbr_month_names").compact)
    RevenueStats do
      RevenueStat(label: :orders, value: 1_208)
      RevenueStat(label: :average_order, value: 39.9, money: true)
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Down on last period
examples.notes: A drop flips the badge to the error color and a falling arrow.
examples.code:
phlex do
  RevenueSummary(value: 9_870, previous: 11_240, period: :week, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    RevenueChart(data: [ 11_240, 10_900, 11_600, 10_300, 9_800, 10_100, 9_870 ], labels: I18n.t("date.abbr_day_names").rotate)
    RevenueStats do
      RevenueStat(label: :orders, value: 312)
      RevenueStat(label: :refunds, value: 14)
      RevenueStat(label: :conversion) { ActiveSupport::NumberHelper.number_to_percentage(2.8, precision: 1, locale: I18n.locale) }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Compact
examples.notes:
Every part is optional: just the total and the markets. Countries without a bundled flag
show their code on a tile.
examples.code:
phlex do
  RevenueSummary(value: 1_845.5, period: :day, currency: "EUR", class: "w-80 max-w-full") do
    RevenueMarkets do
      RevenueMarket(country: :de, value: 1_120, share: 61)
      RevenueMarket(country: :fr, value: 725.5, share: 39)
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Custom wording
examples.notes:
`title:`, `comparison:`, market `name:` and stat labels take plain strings when the built-in
translations don't fit.
examples.code:
phlex do
  RevenueSummary(value: 48_210, previous: 42_900, title: "Store revenue · EU", comparison: "the same month last year", class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    RevenueMarkets(title: "Best-selling regions") do
      RevenueMarket(country: :de, name: "DACH", value: 21_690, share: 45)
    end
    RevenueStats { RevenueStat(label: "New customers", value: 342) }
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes:
Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says: amounts and shares align to the inline end,
and the chart runs in the reading direction.
examples.code:
phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      RevenueSummary(value: 48_210, previous: 42_900, period: :month, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
        RevenueMarkets do
          RevenueMarket(country: :us, value: 21_690, share: 45)
          RevenueMarket(country: :de, value: 9_640, share: 20)
        end
        RevenueChart(data: REVENUE, labels: I18n.t("date.abbr_month_names").compact)
        RevenueStats do
          RevenueStat(label: :orders, value: 1_208)
          RevenueStat(label: :average_order, value: 39.9, money: true)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
